say:1:1430116101:0.text: Oh, I forgot to introduce them. Glintgleam and Big Blue are the short sword and shield I forged.
say:1:1430116101:0.source_cn: 哦，忘了介绍，小光和大蓝是我锻造的短剑和盾牌。

say:2:1430116102:0.text: The moment they were forged, they were destined to leave me and go to Savannah...
say:2:1430116102:0.source_cn: 它们在被锻造完成之时就已经注定要离我而去，去到遥远的赛凡纳。

say:3:1430116103:0.text: As their creator and father, I am a little reluctant to see them go.
say:3:1430116103:0.source_cn: 而我作为它们的创造者，当然会有些不舍。
